cells.note: Temporarily registered clearing agency · United States
cells.detail: PSSC received temporary SEC registration on May 27, 2026 to provide specified CSD and securities-settlement services under an order lasting no more than eighteen months.

sources.label: SEC PSSC temporary clearing-agency registration order

cells.note: Role in the SEC order: supporting layer

cells.text: The current reviewed record remains temporary clearing-agency registration and amended operating materials; no later commencement or production-volume receipt was located through September 27.
cells.detail: Where the proof stops: Registration and operational readiness remain separate from commencement, participant onboarding and settled transactions.

items: Post-trade completion · Securities settlement, Reconciliation + remedy: The legal object is a CSD/securities settlement system, not the venue core.

Interoperability + services · API / integration, Failure authority: The application described connections including a planned DTC participant relationship; actual operating integration remains to be proven.

cells.text: The registration order assessed organizational capacity before operation; it does not prove commencement, unlimited eligible securities, public-DLT venue status or completed integration with DTC.
cells.note: Watch: Commencement notice, participants, eligible securities, DTC participation, corporate-action processing, operational volumes and the later permanent-registration state.
